entities.summary: Roman Stepanovych Smal-Stocki – was a Ukrainian diplomat, scholar, politician. Ph.D. Professor at the Ukrainian Free University. President of the Supreme Council of the Shevchenko Scientific Society and the Scientific Society in the United States.
